adUnit.title: Ad Unit
adUnit.description: Ad unit associated with the line item.

advertiser.title: Advertiser
advertiser.description: Advertiser associated with the line item.

averageDailyImpressions.title: Average Daily Impressions
averageDailyImpressions.description: Average number of ad-server impressions delivered per historical reporting day.

campaignDaysElapsed.title: Campaign Days Elapsed
campaignDaysElapsed.description: Number of campaign days elapsed through the forecast as-of date.

campaignDaysRemaining.title: Campaign Days Remaining
campaignDaysRemaining.description: Number of campaign days remaining after the forecast as-of date.

campaignEndDate.title: Campaign End Date
campaignEndDate.description: Campaign end date from the source data.

campaignStartDate.title: Campaign Start Date
campaignStartDate.description: Campaign start date from the source data.

cpm.title: CPM
cpm.description: Historical effective CPM calculated from revenue and ad-server impressions.

creative.title: Creative
creative.description: Creative associated with the line item.

ctrPercentage.title: CTR Percentage
ctrPercentage.description: Historical click-through rate calculated from clicks and impressions.

deliveryRisk.title: Delivery Risk
deliveryRisk.description: Forecast delivery-risk classification calculated from observed delivery and projected delivery.

explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.description: Human-readable explanation of the calculated forecast results.

fillRatePercentage.title: Fill Rate Percentage
fillRatePercentage.description: Historical served-impression fill rate calculated from served and unfilled impressions.

forecastAsOfDate.title: Forecast As Of Date
forecastAsOfDate.description: Latest historical reporting date used as the forecast cutoff.

goalPercentage.title: Goal Percentage
goalPercentage.description: Goal percentage provided by the source data, when applicable.

goalType.title: Goal Type
goalType.description: Primary goal type provided by the source data.

goalUnits.title: Goal Units
goalUnits.description: Absolute primary goal units provided by the source data, when applicable.

historicalDays.title: Historical Days
historicalDays.description: Number of historical daily records used in the forecast.

historicalImpressions.title: Historical Impressions
historicalImpressions.description: Total historical ad-server impressions observed for the line item.

lineItemId.title: Line Item ID
lineItemId.description: Line item identifier used for the forecast.

lineItemType.title: Line Item Type
lineItemType.description: Line item type provided by the source data.

pacingPercentage.title: Pacing Percentage
pacingPercentage.description: Calculated delivery pacing percentage against the elapsed campaign target for evaluable lifetime goals.

projectedEndImpressions.title: Projected End Impressions
projectedEndImpressions.description: Projected total impressions at campaign end based on observed delivery rates

projectedGoalAttainmentPercentage.title: Projected Goal Attainment Percentage
projectedGoalAttainmentPercentage.description: Projected campaign-end delivery as a percentage of the absolute goal, when an absolute goal is available.

projectedRemainingImpressions.title: Projected Remaining Impressions
projectedRemainingImpressions.description: Projected impressions expected during the remaining campaign period.

recent7DayAverageImpressions.title: Recent 7 Day Average Impressions
recent7DayAverageImpressions.description: Average daily impressions across the most recent seven available reporting days.

recentDeliveryTrendPercentage.title: Recent Delivery Trend Percentage
recentDeliveryTrendPercentage.description: Percentage change between the recent delivery window and the preceding comparable historical window.

requiredDailyImpressions.title: Required Daily Impressions
requiredDailyImpressions.description: Average daily impressions required during the remaining campaign period to reach an evaluable absolute goal.

status.title: Status
status.description: Forecast processing status returned by the forecasting engine.

success.title: Success
success.description: Indicates whether the forecast operation completed successfully.

totalAdRequests.title: Total Ad Requests
totalAdRequests.description: Total historical ad requests observed for the line item.

totalClicks.title: Total Clicks
totalClicks.description: Total historical clicks observed for the line item.

totalRevenue.title: Total Revenue
totalRevenue.description: Total historical ad-server revenue observed for the line item.

totalUnfilledImpressions.title: Total Unfilled Impressions
totalUnfilledImpressions.description: Total historical unfilled impressions observed for the line item.

viewabilityPercentage.title: Viewability Percentage
viewabilityPercentage.description: Historical Active View viewability percentage calculated from measurable and viewable impressions.
